info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Connect Components Institution Oauth Url-v5-spec
info.description: The Institution OAuth URL Creation API enables clients to generate OAuth URLs for specific institutions, facilitating secure authentication and authorization. This endpoint is particularly useful for developers integrating third-party applications that require secure access to institutional resources. By sending a POST request with the necessary institution ID, users can initiate the creation of OAuth URLs tailored to their application needs. Typical consumers include software developers and system integrators working in financial services or educational sectors.

post.summary: Create OAuth URL for an institution.
post.description: This operation allows the client to generate an OAuth URL specific to the institution identified by RES-100045, enabling secure authorization for user access to resources.
